notes: Trivial no-arg constructor (leaves anInt6976 at its default 0). Extends LinkedListNode so instances are meant to be linked into HashLinkedList/Hashtable-style structures (see uses via method3480/method3483/method3484 lookups in CacheArchiveIndex, WidgetComponent, StructConfig, NpcConfig, ParamMap, etc.) as a generic single-int-payload node.

Sets anInt6976 = i (the node's stored int payload/key). Confirmed by many call sites constructing `IntKeyNode(someInt)` and inserting into a Hashtable/NodeDeque keyed by a separate id (e.g. GlRenderDevice.kt, OpenGlRenderer.kt, WidgetComponent.kt, SceneEntityModel.kt), then later reading back `.anInt6976` as the stored value (e.g. ProjectileNode.kt: `(hashtable.method3480(...) as IntKeyNode).anInt6976`). Field itself (anInt6976) is best read as a generic `value`/payload rather than a 'key', since the actual lookup key is the hashtable/long key used to store the node, not this field.
